purpose: Activate the independently admitted Local Mistral reviewer as an exact-head provider without changing the shared review-gate verifier in this PR.
requiredInvariants: Local Qwen is the independent reviewer for this Local Mistral provider activation PR.
The active provider loads the already admitted Local Mistral authority, binding, runtime, sensitive-output and attestation modules only from trusted main under pull_request_target.
A PR changing Local Mistral provider or bootstrap authority paths cannot be reviewed by Local Mistral.
A PR changing both Local Qwen and Local Mistral authority paths fails closed.
The PR head is checked before review input capture and again before any review or provider status publication.
The reviewed diff is bounded to 64000 bytes and changed paths to 96; oversized input fails closed.
No raw model candidate leaves the model host; only a sensitive-output-filtered canonical result and evidence hashes return to GitHub Actions.
Clean review publication uses the admitted canonical attestation renderer; blocking findings are published only after sensitive-output filtering and structural validation.
The provider publishes review-provider/local-mistral and no Octopus or paid SaaS/API authority is required.
The shared provider-neutral exact-head verifier is deliberately unchanged here and will be extended in a separately reviewed PR after provider activation.
Production hosting remains REG_RU_VPS_ONLY and new recurring cost remains 0 RUB.
